01 — Your local gym

A gym that feels
like Hāwera.

Not a big-city chain, not a cold warehouse of machines. Hawera Gym & Fitness Centre is the town’s own gym — friendly faces, room to move, and training that fits real life.

Train your way.

Weights, machines and cardio space to work through your own session — at your own pace, in your own time.

Community first

Everyone’s welcome here.

First session or five hundredth — you’ll find people happy to help you settle in and get going.

Right in town

Easy to find,
easy to keep coming.

On Princes Street in the heart of Hāwera — pop in on your way past and see the gym for yourself.

Get started

Keen to join? Just ask.

Send us an email and we’ll talk you through joining — no pressure, no hard sell, just honest answers.

Email the gym →
02 — Inside the gym

Room to move.
Kit to work with.

A big open floor to train on, with free weights, resistance machines and a dedicated cardio area — plus space to stretch out and warm up properly. Everything you need for a solid session, nothing you don’t.
